item.futuretinker.wolf_armor.description: Armor built for a wolf: right-click a tamed wolf to put it on, shears take it off.
item.futuretinker.spear.description: Hold right-click to lower the spear: charge damage scales with the speed of you and your target, and a fast enough joust dismounts riders. Jabs reach 4.5 blocks and can hit several targets, but cannot hit inside 2 blocks.
item.futuretinker.spear_head.description: The head: its durability sets the spear's tier, which drives the charge multiplier and dismount threshold.
